name: Sedmice
summary: Trick-taking card game where tricks are won by matching rank and Sevens are wild.
rules_text: Sedmice is played with 32 cards (7-A) with 4 cards dealt to each player, rest as talon. Leader plays any card. Following players each play one card. A trick is won by the last player to play a card equal in rank to the led card, or any Seven which is wild. If the current trick winner is an opponent of the original leader, the leader may extend the trick by playing another equal-rank or Seven, then all other players must play another card in order. Extension can repeat. Winner takes all cards of the trick to their side. After each trick all players draw from talon to return to 4 cards until talon empty, then play out remaining hands. Aces and Tens are worth 10 each, plus 10 for last trick, 90 total per deal. Deal winner needs 50+ points. Match is first to 120 points. In 4-player version players form two fixed pairs.
rating_reason: Same Sedma family, matching rank tricks, Sevens wild, clear rules
